title: How often does my child need to attend Occupational Therapy sessions at Pinnacle?
metaTitle: Frequency of Occupational Therapy Sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand how the expert occupational therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network determine the right frequency of therapy sessions for your child's unique needs.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that every child is unique with their own unique set of skills, strengths, and areas that need improvement. Because of this, the frequency of Occupational Therapy sessions can differ from child to child. Following a thorough assessment, our expert therapists will recommend a frequency plan that is just right for your child, which could differ from multiple sessions per week, to fewer, based on your child's individual needs and progress goals. Rest assured, we are all about personalizing the therapy experience for maximizing potential.
